nthe17.title: Plus one?
nthe17.caption: Libra is hosting the party and the crush already RSVP'd as a guest. Can the host have a plus one? Gemini answered three messages at once. Virgo said ask, then let them pick. They picked date. Who's your chat's Libra?

nthe18.title: Family on video
nthe18.caption: Ten minutes to meet the family on video. Capricorn sent an agenda, Aries said be loud. One question about the garden and grandma was sold. Who's your chat's calm one before big calls?

nthe19.title: No context
nthe19.caption: Sag dropped a map pin and nothing else. The chat guessed three places in one bubble. Virgo's tip: surprise them with the place, let them keep the weekend. Which sign sends pins with no context?

nthe20.title: Any other business
nthe20.caption: Capricorn put feelings on the agenda as item three, then admitted they answered I love you with noted. The fix took five minutes and got minuted. Which sign would reply noted?

nthe21.title: Wrong chat
nthe21.caption: Aries announced the secret gift exchange pick in the group chat. Virgo saw nothing, apparently. The best gift idea came from one question: what did you notice? Who in your chat can't keep a secret?

nthe22.title: The poll
nthe22.caption: Cancer made a dinner poll and every vote landed somewhere different. Gemini voted three times. Pick the night most can do, save a seat on a screen for the rest. Who runs the polls in your chat?

nthe23.title: Pinned (again)
nthe23.caption: Leo pinned their own message again, then spiraled over one soup joke. Virgo: ask what makes them laugh. Now the pinned message is their date's goose story. Which sign pins their own compliments?

nthe24.title: The coat room
nthe24.caption: Libra hosted the party, then hid in the coat room texting the chat. Going back out with some water and a smile paid off: a seat with their name on a napkin. Ever hidden at your own party?

nthe25.title: Gift reveals
nthe25.caption: Gift exchange reveals: Taurus got two pairs of socks and wore both. Aquarius got a lamp shaped like Leo. Thank them for the thought, it's real. What's the funniest gift your chat has swapped?

nthe26.title: New season, new me
nthe26.caption: It's Capricorn season and Capricorn announced feelings. Then a résumé for meeting the partner's friends. Swapped for one question about their dog: three new friends. Who in your chat brings a résumé?

nthe27.title: Sixty photos
nthe27.caption: Sag came home from the surprise trip with sixty photos and plans for the next one. Their person was tired. Turns out blanket, soup and one film is also a trip. Which sign plans the next trip on the way home?

nthe28.title: Three threads
nthe28.caption: Three questions at once, one Gemini, one bubble: chocolate chip, yes, tell them. Scorpio did, and they like them back. Gemini is taking full credit. Who in your chat is accidentally wise?

nthe29.title: Forwarded
nthe29.caption: Pisces forwarded their date's voice note, too emotional to hear it twice. Scorpio played it: a made-up song that rhymes Pisces with nice is. Saying what it meant took one second. Who sends the voice notes?

nthe30.title: Dietary needs
nthe30.caption: Cancer asked for dietary needs and got yes, spicy, something new and a spreadsheet. The real question: their partner's family recipe. Virgo: ask them to teach you. Who in your chat would try the surprise anyway?

nthe31.title: Best moment
nthe31.caption: Leo asked for everyone's best moment of the year and the chat brought callbacks. Aries said it was a bad year for love. Virgo said learning what you want counts. What did your year teach you?

nthe32.title: Why so quiet?
nthe32.caption: The group chat went quiet for hours. Pisces got worried. Everyone was at the same table, Pisces included. The bread burnt and nobody cared. Who would you put down your phone for?
